notes.random: It is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. This strategy was picked from the cb_bbkc_es_v2_15m finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, overlap with each other) as well as 2018–2022, and the grid itself was chosen after reading round 1 on 2023–2024, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. It shows the strategies held up; it can't prove it. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: Not a clean test: the compression-breakout holdout for ES was used 5 time(s) before this run. Treat these numbers as a check, not independent proof.
